text:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Pager duty alert — API Gateway 502/504 spike in eu-west starting ~10:02 UTC. Error rate up to 18% for /v1/generate. Triggering oncall.
alex: ack, jumping in. which fleet is hot? any service-level logs?
maria: I'm seeing increased upstream timeouts from edge->ingress-proxy, 504s mainly. tcp retries spike too. top pod: ingress-proxy-eu-03.
dan: also noticing a gradual traffic shift from canary at 09:58 — envoy filter rollout 2.1.4. correlate?
priya: @dan can you confirm the canary's envoy config changes? could be a header rewrite causing upstream mismatch.
dan: looking — config changed keepalive + connection pool limits. I can roll it back if needed.
alex: hold on rollback until we try routing fallback. quick mitigation: divert 30% traffic away from ingress-proxy-eu-03 to ingress-proxy-eu-01/02 and increase per-connection timeout.
maria: running tcpdump on ingress-proxy-eu-03 to see FIN patterns. attaching a snippet:
```
15:10:23.123456 IP 10.0.5.3:54321 > 10.0.9.7:443: Flags [F.], seq 12345, ack 67890
... repeated close after TLS handshake
```
priya: that looks like upstream closing early. Could be backend kv cache eviction flooding connections. investigating model-serving pool.
support: customer-impact: scoreboard shows elevated 5xx for ~100 orgs; mainly small PD/PLG customers, but a handful of mid-market customers seeing >30% failures. Raising a customer-notify draft.
product: from a product POV, endpoints affected include chat streaming and non-stream generate. embeddings unaffected.
deply-bot: (typo) deploy-bot: rollback job queued for envoy filter canary -> job 87321. require manual confirm?
alex: do not rollback yet. apply traffic diversion first. Dan — give me the router update command.
dan: run:
```bash
curl -X POST https://router-control.internal/shift -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN' -d '{"service":"ingress-proxy","region":"eu-west","weights":{"ingress-proxy-eu-01":0.35,"ingress-proxy-eu-02":0.35,"ingress-proxy-eu-03":0.30}}'
```
alex: running now.
(systems): router-control: shift accepted, new weights applied.
maria: metrics updating, error rate on ingress-proxy-eu-03 dipping from 18% -> 9% over 30s. overall API 5xx down to 7%.
priya: backend reports increased connection churn but pool capacity holding. I'm bumping upstream timeouts from 3s -> 6s for the downstream route.
alex: good. @support prepare customer note: "We observed elevated 502/504 errors due to an edge routing issue; mitigation is in progress, some customers may see intermittent failures. We will update in 30 minutes."
support: drafting and will send once we confirm stabilization.
dan: since traffic diversion helped, I'm going to stop the canary rollout (pause) and leave stable rollout off. deploy-bot: pause Canary job 87321.
deply-bot: Canary job 87321 paused by dan.
product: ETA on full recovery? need to update sales for impacted mid-market accounts.
maria: 5xx at platform level trending to baseline (2-3%) after 6 minutes. still seeing isolated timeouts on one backend shard.
priya: pinpointed root cause: a connection pool regression in the new envoy filter under high TLS session churn — leads to fd starvation on ingress-proxy-eu-03. will prepare a patch to revert the pool behavior.
alex: action items: 1) Dan to fully roll back envoy filter from canary -> pause and schedule patch revert. 2) Priya to push fix and run small canary. 3) Maria to monitor for 15m. 4) Support to notify impacted customers. 5) Handoff to next oncall with summary.
dan: rolling rollback to stable config now.
deply-bot: rollback started; job 87345 in progress.
maria: monitoring — ingress-proxy-eu-03 error rate back to 2.1% after rollback. overall 5xx at 1.8%.
support: customer note sent to affected orgs, CS escalation for 4 customers.
product: thanks. we should add this case to the next postmortem and consider adding a safety gate for keepalive/pool changes.
alex: agreed — I'll own the postmortem. tagging @product to add to roadmap for longer-term guardrails.
priya: I'll cut a PR for the envoy pool fix and attach perf tests for TLS churn.
(sre-bot): Incident severity downgraded to S2 — monitoring for 30m.
alex: handing off to next oncall (priya) — notes: cause = envoy pool regression during canary; mitigation = traffic diversion + rollback; impacted = eu-west generate endpoints; customer impact = intermittent 5xx affecting ~100 orgs, 4 escalations.
priya: taking over. I'll keep monitoring and run the postmortem checklist.
sre-bot: incident closed at 10:15 UTC (stabilized). follow-up: add postmortem link when ready. :thumbsup:
